title: bug: action_save defined twice — @on handler silently dropped
description: Python overwrites the first action_save definition (L479) with the second (L503). The @on(Button.Pressed, '#btn-save') decorator is discarded, so the Save button may have no registered handler. The 's' key binding fires Button.press() but nothing listens.

title: Refactor: make HTTP transport injectable in send_color_to_wled
description:
Tests currently mock urllib.request.urlopen globally via patch(). This is a fragile global seam.

Add an optional opener parameter to send_color_to_wled defaulting to urllib.request.urlopen. Tests pass a fake opener directly — no patch() needed.

Acceptance:
- send_color_to_wled accepts optional opener kwarg
- Test for correct payload uses a fake opener, not patch()
- Default behavior (no opener passed) unchanged

title: Refactor: replace source string branching with ColorSource protocol
description:
The string 'bg'/'accent' leaks through watch(), _poll(), _is_bg_event(), and main(). Every new source requires adding branches in multiple places.

Replace with a ColorSource protocol so all branching is confined to main() where the source is constructed. watch() and _poll() receive a ColorSource, not a string.

Acceptance:
- No 'source == bg' branches outside of main()
- _is_bg_event disappears into BgColorSource
- All existing tests pass

title: Refactor: extract ColorSource abstraction to eliminate watch/poll duplication
description:
watch() and _poll() duplicate change-detection, deduplication, push, and error handling logic. Both branch on the 'source' string to compute a sentinel and call read_color(). Adding a new source requires touching both.

Extract a ColorSource dataclass/protocol with read() and sentinel() methods. AccentColorSource and BgColorSource implement it. The event loop becomes source-agnostic and is implemented once.

Acceptance:
- Single loop implementation drives both inotify and poll paths
- ColorSource has read() -> RGB and sentinel() -> comparable value
- All existing tests pass
- New tests cover each ColorSource in isolation
design: ColorSource protocol with read() and sentinel(). AccentColorSource wraps read_accent_color + theme.name mtime. BgColorSource wraps read_bg_color + readlink target string. Loop calls source.sentinel() to detect changes, source.read() to get color.

title: Refactor: extract push_if_changed() to make Handler testable
description:
Handler is defined inside watch(), closing over ip, brightness, saturation, source. The push logic (dedup + apply_saturation + send) is buried and untestable without standing up a full watch() call.

Extract push_if_changed(source, state, wled_ip, brightness, saturation) as a standalone function. Handler becomes a thin adapter that calls it. Tests can call push_if_changed directly.

Acceptance:
- push_if_changed is a top-level function
- Tests cover dedup (same color not resent), saturation application, and send
- Handler is a thin adapter (<10 lines)

title: Implement Omarchy-style TUI for Configuration (real-time feedback, service control, theme-aware)
description:
Create a text-based user interface (TUI) for omarchy-wled, designed in the Omarchy style, to provide users with an intuitive experience for configuring all relevant settings. The TUI should:

- Match the look and feel of other Omarchy interfaces and automatically adapt to Omarchy theme changes (e.g., accent color, background, etc.)
- Watch for Omarchy theme changes and update TUI appearance and options accordingly (respecting colors and theme configuration at runtime)
- Allow users to view and adjust all available configuration options (such as WLED IP, color source, brightness, saturation, etc.)
- Display actionable, real-time feedback as users change settings
- Enable or disable the omarchy-wled system service (`systemctl --user enable/disable --now omarchy-wled@<ip>`) directly from the interface
- Provide clear navigation and error/status messages in line with Omarchy UI conventions
- Be user-friendly and robust against input errors (keyboard only)

---

### References

- **All runtime logic:** [`omarchy_wled.py`](https://github.com/ericdahl-dev/omarchy-wled/blob/main/omarchy_wled.py)
- **Configuration/data paths:**
  - `~/.config/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml` (color hex values)
  - `~/.config/omarchy/current/theme.name` (theme, triggers updates)
  - `~/.config/omarchy/current/background` (wallpaper symlink)
- **Systemd user service:** [`omarchy-wled@.service`](https://github.com/ericdahl-dev/omarchy-wled/blob/main/omarchy-wled@.service), [README.md "Auto-start (systemd)"](https://github.com/ericdahl-dev/omarchy-wled#auto-start-systemd)
- **Command-line configuration:** See [`main()`/CLI in omarchy_wled.py](https://github.com/ericdahl-dev/omarchy-wled/blob/main/omarchy_wled.py#L254)

---

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Launches with clear instructions or a welcome screen
- TUI watches for Omarchy theme changes and updates its appearance to match in real time
- Users can interactively configure settings, seeing immediate feedback for any changes
- Users can enable or disable the omarchy-wled service without leaving the TUI
- Error and status feedback follows Omarchy TUI conventions
- Code is tested and linted where applicable

Please link this issue to any relevant, related issues or feature requests.

title: refactor: BgColorSource.is_trigger matches by name only — should use resolve()
description:
## Problem

`BgColorSource.is_trigger` matches by filename only:

```python
return Path(event_path).name == BACKGROUND_LINK.name  # "background"
```

Any file named `background` anywhere would match if the watch scope were ever broadened. `ThemeColorSource.is_trigger` correctly uses `.resolve()` equality — the two implementations are inconsistent.

## Fix

Use full path resolution, consistent with `ThemeColorSource`:
```python
return Path(event_path).resolve() == BACKGROUND_LINK.resolve()
```

title: bug: _poll creates its own state dict — orphans watch() state on fallback
description:
## Problem

`watch()` creates `state = {}` before falling back to `_poll()`, but `_poll` creates its own `state = {}` internally (L244). The state from `watch()` is orphaned — any color pushed before the fallback decision is lost on the next call.

## Fix

Pass `state` into `_poll` instead of re-creating it, so state is shared across the fallback boundary.

title: refactor: watchdog and Pillow should be optional dependencies
description:
## Problem

`watchdog` and `Pillow` are listed as hard dependencies in `pyproject.toml`, but both are caught with try/except at runtime. Neither is required for the default `accent`/`fg` use case. Users get two heavy packages they may not need.

## Fix

Move to `[project.optional-dependencies]`:
```toml
[project.optional-dependencies]
watch = ["watchdog>=4.0"]
bg = ["Pillow>=10.0"]
```

title: refactor: sentinel() leaks poll-only concern onto ColorSource protocol
description:
## Problem

`sentinel()` is defined on the `ColorSource` protocol but only called by `_poll()` — a fallback inside a fallback. Callers of the protocol don't need to know about polling internals. The method makes the interface harder to understand than it needs to be.

## Fix

Move `sentinel()` off the protocol. Either pass it as a callable into `_poll`, or give `_poll` its own narrower interface.

title: refactor: remove shallow read_accent_color / read_foreground_color wrappers
description:
## Problem

`read_accent_color` and `read_foreground_color` (L76–83) are thin wrappers over `_read_color_key`. They're only referenced in tests and imply a stable public API that doesn't exist. Deletion test passes — removing them concentrates no complexity.

## Fix

Remove both functions. Tests should use `ThemeColorSource` or `_read_color_key` directly.

title: bug: watch() ignores source.watch_path() — BgColorSource never triggers
description:
## Problem

`watch()` hardcodes `THEME_NAME_FILE.parent` as the watched directory regardless of the active source. `BgColorSource` (and any future source) never fires because the observer watches the wrong directory.

```python
# L224 — always watches theme dir
observer.schedule(Handler(), str(THEME_NAME_FILE.parent), recursive=False)
# should be:
observer.schedule(Handler(), str(source.watch_path().parent), recursive=False)
```

The `watch_path()` seam exists on the `ColorSource` protocol precisely for this — it's just unused.

## Fix

Replace the hardcoded path with `source.watch_path().parent`.
